summary: Volens, a tower in Halifax County, Virginia, is listed as gone; the two sources read give only its name, county, coordinates and status.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no removal date or cause in the sources read.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Association list gives name, county, coordinates and gone status only. The Forest Lookouts Virginia page has the name and county as a heading with no description, and no subpage is linked. Not in the firetower.org or NHLR caches, so there is no register record. Two WebSearch queries returned nothing about this tower. No source read explains the name. The story is about 100 words, below the usual 120, and was not padded. The brief record checks out (Halifax County, gone); no correction. Next checks: Virginia Department of Forestry or Halifax County records, and local newspapers from the period the tower was in use.
